utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. Madam Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case number IT-97-25/1-I, the Prosecutor versus Savo Todovic and Mitar Rasevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. May I have the appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. SMITH
utterances.text: If Your Honours pleases, Bill Smith for the Prosecution with David Leese as case manager. And Your Honour, for the record, Ms. Hildegard Uertz-Retzlaff will be the senior trial attorney taking conduct in this matter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Branko Lukic for the Defence, representing Mr. Rasevic today on his Initial Appearance.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. We proceed with the Initial Appearance of the accused, Mitar Rasevic, pursuant to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Mr. Rasevic, can you hear the proceedings in a language that you understand? Is the translation correct?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: So we have a problem. May I repeat. Can you hear me now? Is that now okay? Can you hear me? Still not.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm not receiving any interpretation in Serbian.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Can you hear me now?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I can hear it now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: So now I understand you can hear me correctly.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: So, Mr. Rasevic, first I would like you to give your full name for the record.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] My name is Rasevic, Mitar.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Do you have any nickname, or is this the name always used?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Just this name.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Now what is your date of birth?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 15th of November, 1949.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. What is the address at which you resided before you came into the custody of the Tribunal?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Stijepe Stanivice BB [phoen], Foca.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, Mr. Rasevic, have you received the indictment in a language that you understand, and did you have the chance to read it?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I received the indictment in the language I can understand, and I have read it. Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: So do you understand its content?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Did you have the opportunity to discuss the indictment with counsel and are you prepared to plead today, or do you want to plead at a later stage?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I would not like to plead today. I would like to plead within 30 days, in relation to the indictment and my plea.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Rasevic. As you know, this -- as you mentioned, this Initial Appearance, you have the right to plead guilty or not guilty to each of the counts, or you can do it within 30 days from this Initial Appearance. I understand you have chosen to do it at a later stage and not today. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: In any case, I think it should be opportune to have the indictment read out to you today.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As far as I'm concerned, it is not necessary because I've read it and I've understood it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Okay. So you waive your right to have the indictment read fully to you during this hearing?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Okay. I thank you. So I take it that another hearing will be held to allow you to plead, within 30 days from now. I wish to tell you that shall you fail to enter a plea within this time limit, the Trial Chamber shall enter a plea of not guilty on your behalf. This is what the Rules provide for. So in this situation, the Registrar will be instructed to fix a date for another hearing to allow the accused to plead guilty or not guilty. In the meantime, the accused is to remain in custody, in the detention facilities here in The Hague, until further order. At this stage, is there any matter that the Prosecution wishes to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. SMITH
utterances.text: Nothing further, Your Honour, apart from the fact the supporting material is available. And I've spoken to my learned friend, who has asked that he not receive the material as his assignment at this stage is an Initial Appearance assignment. And when such counsel is assigned for a longer period, the material will be provided within that 30 days.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Is there any other matter that the Defence wishes to raise at this stage?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, there is nothing on our side to raise at this moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: May I turn to Mr. Rasevic. Mr. Rasevic, when you mentioned your date of birth, I'm just now reminded, you mentioned 1949. The indictment is mentioning 1940. Which is the correct date, just to clarify the point?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I've seen that there is a mistake in the indictment, mentioning 1940. The exact date of birth is the 15th of November, 1949.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Rasevic. So in the circumstances, if there is no other question to be dealt with, I think that we can adjourn the proceedings until the next hearing in which the accused will plead guilty or not guilty. The hearing is adjourned.
